blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives is coordinating with the Senate to once again open to the public the joint congressional talks on the P7.2-trillion spending plan for next year, Nueva Ecija Rep. Mikaela Angela Suansing said on Tuesday. She said congressmen are organizing efforts to open the traditionally close-door budget talks with senators
